explainer.title: What Souply recognises
explainer.body: Souply highlights each data field on the receipt with a coloured frame so you can see exactly which pixels were read and what information is collected. This data is used only for price comparison and your personal purchase analysis.
explainer.addressBody: Store address — used to match against our store catalog.
explainer.companyCodeBody: The retailer's company / VAT code — chain details, not the store address.
explainer.productsBody: Every purchased item with name, quantity, and price.
explainer.receiptNoBody: Unique receipt number — used to distinguish re-uploaded photos.
explainer.skippedBody: Coupons, bags and loyalty-points lines — recognised but intentionally not counted as products.
explainer.privateBody: Bank card, loyalty card numbers and the cashier's name are blacked out on your phone — this data is never stored or uploaded.

discountsSheet.title: Promotions
discountsSheet.explainer: These discounts are provided by {{chain}}. Other stores might have bigger discounts or lower regular prices — compare your basket before shopping to find the best deals.

impulseSheet.title: Impulse
impulseSheet.note: The odd unplanned item is fine. But pricier unplanned purchases can skew our store recommendations, so try to stick to your plan to keep comparisons as accurate as possible.

missedSheet.title: Missed
missedSheet.note: Skipping the odd planned item is fine. But the more your basket drifts from your plan, the less accurately we can compare stores and pick the best one. Try to keep your basket as close to your plan as possible for the best recommendations.

predictionSheet.title: Prediction
predictionSheet.note: Accuracy is measured by comparing the products you bought against your shopping list. In store, always check the price per unit — you can sometimes find a better deal.
